mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (title, description, category, image_url, demo_url, github_url, date) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{category}, #{imageUrl}, #{demoUrl}, #{githubUrl}, #{date})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM project ORDER BY date DESC
SELECT * FROM project WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%') ORDER BY date DESC
SELECT * FROM project WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY date DESC

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.category, p.image_url, p.demo_url, p.github_url, p.date, p.created_at, t.id as tech_id, t.name as tech_name, t.category as tech_category, t.icon as tech_icon, t.created_at as tech_created_at, pt.sort_order FROM project p LEFT JOIN project_tech pt ON p.id = pt.project_id LEFT JOIN tech t ON pt.tech_id = t.id ORDER BY p.date DESC, pt.sort_order ASC

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.category, p.image_url, p.demo_url, p.github_url, p.date, p.created_at, t.id as tech_id, t.name as tech_name, t.category as tech_category, t.icon as tech_icon, t.created_at as tech_created_at, pt.sort_order FROM project p INNER JOIN project_tech pt ON p.id = pt.project_id INNER JOIN tech t ON pt.tech_id = t.id WHERE t.name = #{techName} ORDER BY p.date DESC, pt.sort_order ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, demo_url = #{demoUrl}, github_url = #{githubUrl}, date = #{date} WHERE id = #{id}
